animation.dynamic_translation: For motion plunger or switch_stem: worldZ = exportedZ - 0.25*progress. Fixed parts do not move.
animation.actuator_clip: For part switch_stem only, fragment shader MUST discard if transformed worldZ < part.clipMinZ (12.5). Apply after motion translation.
animation.actuator_overlap: Fixed lower ends at12.5. Moving upper begins at12.25, extends to12.0 after fullpress. Internal horizontal split caps omitted on both meshes. Clip prevents overlap z-fighting and an exposed artificial split plane.
animation.cut_direction: Removed all material Y<9. View from negativeY toward positiveY to see opaque section faces. Z is up.
animation.groups: start and count index the flat indices array; group.material selects materials[0] exterior or materials[1] opaque front-cut surface.

parts.label: Actual carrier copper pads and plating
Actual SW1 fixed housing and leads

limits: External reference-stroke motion only; switch springs, internal electrical contacts, tolerances and force are not modeled.
PCB uses ten actual solids: one substrate and nine copper/pad/plating pieces. Detached zero-thickness soldermask surfaces are omitted.
Opaque front faces are real boolean cut surfaces. Artificial actuator split caps are omitted and moving actuator is clipped as documented.
